senses.zh: n.生物学 生态学

ex.en: "Thus body weight is strongly influenced by biology—it is not an individual's fault if they develop obesity."
For their study—outlined in a paper in the journal Conservation Biology—the team looked at genetic diversity and spread among a Chinese panda population.

tip: 学科名称，通常不可数；生物学家是biologist。

sourceRows.zh: n.生物学 生态学

senses.zh: n.鸟 家禽 陶土飞靶 伙伴 vi.观察或辨认鸟

ex.en: A decorated egg with a bird on it, given to a young married couple, is a wish for children.
Learn five species of bird, five butterflies, five trees, five bird songs.

tip: 鸟群用a flock of birds；bird本身是可数名词。

sourceRows.zh: n.鸟 家禽 陶土飞靶 伙伴 vi.观察或辨认鸟

senses.zh: n.分娩 出生 诞生 出身 血统 出现 起源

ex.en: A number of past studies have found the link between season of birth and mental health diagnoses.
I think it was during the 1600s and the princess at that time died while giving birth to her 14th child.

col: the birth of a movement｜一场运动的诞生
tip: give birth to表示生下；be born表示出生。

sourceRows.zh: n.分娩 出生 诞生 出身 血统 出现 起源

senses.zh: n.生日 诞生的日期

ex.en: Exactly or even simply see your birthday as an opportunity to bring people together for them to have fun.
Wilbur has his own Internet pages as he approaches his 10th birthday on July, 7.

tip: 在某人生日当天用on，不用in或at。

sourceRows.zh: n.生日 诞生的日期

senses.zh: n.(英)饼干 (美)软饼 姜黄褐色

ex.en: Why not have another Jammie Dodger biscuit and forget about it.
The teens chose healthy snacks and drinks (such as fruit or water) more often over unhealthy options (like biscuits and soda).

col: a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干
tip: 英式biscuit通常对应美式cookie；美式另指松软面包。

sourceRows.zh: n.(英)饼干 (美)软饼 姜黄褐色

senses.zh: n.一点 少量 一些 小片 钻头 马嚼子 辅币 位 比特(二进位制信息单位) vt.控制

ex.en: Hyphenating the two names is a way for each person to, at least a little bit, "win" the argument.
The art of telling a story using music has not faded in the least bit.

tip: a bit of接名词；a bit可修饰形容词；bit也是bite过去式。

senses.zh: n.咬 一口 少量食物 咬伤的伤口 vt.咬 叮 螫 剌穿 vi.咬 (饵) 使剧痛 紧抓

ex.en: "Maybe the best sign that Impossible Foods has cracked the code to realistic fake meat is that I couldn't stand to take another bite," she wrote.
For example,other studies have found dogs are more likely to bite children versus adults.

tip: 过去式bit，过去分词bitten；一口用a bite。
